summary_hint: TRID Closing Disclosure (final) for <borrower_name> on loan <loan_number>: amount <loan_amount> at <interest_rate>, APR <apr>, closing <closing_date>, cash to close <cash_to_close>.

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity — the loan id (Loan ID #); the join key to the file's other documents
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Loan ID #', captured verbatim; masked + hashed at the snapshot boundary

typed_core.name: disbursement_date
typed_core.why: processor — 'Disbursement Date' (CD-only; an LE has none)

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — the borrower; match to the file

typed_core.name: seller_name
typed_core.why: identity — the seller (CD-only; an LE has no seller)

typed_core.name: sale_price
typed_core.why: processor — 'Sale Price' (or 'Est. Prop. Value' on a refinance)
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Sale Price' (or 'Est. Prop. Value' for a refinance)

typed_core.name: interest_rate
typed_core.why: processor — 'Interest Rate' (the initial rate if it can increase)
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Interest Rate' — the initial rate as printed

typed_core.name: loan_product
typed_core.why: processor — the product (e.g. 'Fixed Rate', an ARM product)

typed_core.name: loan_type
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Loan Type' (the checked box: Conventional / FHA / VA)

typed_core.name: apr
typed_core.why: processor — Annual Percentage Rate (page-5 Loan Calculations); a number a processor checks
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Annual Percentage Rate (APR)' in the Loan Calculations box (page 5)

typed_core.name: total_of_payments
typed_core.why: processor — 'Total of Payments' (CD-only; page-5 Loan Calculations)

typed_core.name: estimated_total_monthly_payment
typed_core.why: processor — 'Estimated Total Monthly Payment' (the FIRST-period value if it varies)
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Estimated Total Monthly Payment' — the first period's value if the schedule steps

typed_core.name: total_closing_costs
typed_core.why: processor — 'Closing Costs' / Total Closing Costs (J); a number a processor checks

typed_core.name: prepayment_penalty_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — whether the loan has a prepayment penalty (YES/NO)

typed_core.name: balloon_payment_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — whether the loan has a balloon payment (YES/NO)

rejected.name: A-J itemized closing-cost tables
rejected.reason: the full Loan Costs (A-C) + Other Costs (E-H) itemization serves TRID tolerance rules (DC-4/DC-5), which are OUT OF SCOPE (LOS function). The headline total_closing_costs (J) is captured; the itemization goes to Tier 3 until a rule needs it. Building it for zero in-scope rules is disproportionate (ADR).

rejected.name: borrower + seller transaction summaries (page 3)
rejected.reason: the K/L/M/N summaries + adjustments serve the settlement math, no in-scope rule; cash_to_close (the headline number) is captured. Tier 3.

rejected.name: payoffs and payments list
rejected.reason: the payoff detail (refi) serves no in-scope rule; Tier 3.

rejected.name: AIR / AP / adjustable-rate tables
rejected.reason: ARM adjustment caps/indices — no in-scope rule; the initial interest_rate is captured; the AIR table is Tier 3.

rejected.name: contact information block (page 5)
rejected.reason: lender/broker/settlement contact names, NMLS IDs, phones — not captured (avoids phone/NMLS PII handling for a visibility type); Tier 3.

encoding_variations: the CD is the standard ~5-page TRID form; the headline spans page 1 (Loan Terms / Projected Payments / Costs at Closing) + page 5 (Loan Calculations: APR, Finance Charge, Amount Financed, Total of Payments, TIP)
sale_price is 'Sale Price' on a purchase and 'Est. Prop. Value' on a refinance
Estimated Total Monthly Payment steps by period (e.g. Years 1-6 vs 7-30) — capture the first period
on an ARM the interest rate can increase after closing ('Can this amount increase after closing? YES'); interest_rate is the initial rate

open_questions.q: Headline block vs the full ~140-field CD?
options: the full form (cost tables, transaction summaries, payoffs, ARM tables)
open_questions.recommendation: HEADLINE ONLY (GEET'S DECISION, LP-470): no in-scope rule reads a CD (CL-2..7 and DC-1..7 are out of pre-submission scope), so it earns Tier 1 on processor visibility, not rule coverage. Tier 3 free extraction carries the rest until a rule needs it. If DC-4/DC-5 are confirmed in scope, the cost tables become necessary (ADR).

notes: closing_disclosure was an existing Tier-2 catalog type (recognized, no extractor); this PROMOTES it to Tier 1 with the headline schema. No in-scope rule reads it — it earns Tier 1 on processor visibility (the wire_instructions / ACORD 25 standard, ADR-362/363).

~80% shared with loan_estimate; the specs are separate (two catalog types) but the shared skeleton is identical. CD-only here: closing_date, disbursement_date, settlement_agent, seller_name, finance_charge, amount_financed, total_of_payments.

PII: only loan_number (reuses the global registration — masked + hashed). No account numbers in the headline (they live in the excluded payoff/transaction tables); the contact block is not captured, so no phone/NMLS PII.
